title: Bit to Integer Converter
text: Map vector of bits to corresponding vector of integers, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Output data type} sets Output data type Inherit via internal; {Number of bits per integer(M)}, {Input bit order} and {After bit packing, treat resulting integer values as} sets the flag for signed integer values after bit packing. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In
ports.summary: Input signal bit scalar | column vector of bits

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: Output signal integer | column vector of integers

params.name: Number of bits per integer(M)
params.values: Number of bits per integer 3 (default) | integer in the range [1, 32]

params.name: Input bit order
params.values: Input bit order MSB first (default) | LSB first

params.name: After bit packing, treat resulting integer values as
params.values: Flag for signed integer values after bit packing Unsigned (default) | Signed

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type Inherit via internal rule (default) | Smallest integer | Same as input | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32
